text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the banquet hall of a large hotel. 
As I sit on a plush reception chair, a 
spotlight pierces through the darkness.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttore— Welcome to our concert!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttriceâ Welcome to our concert!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, with every ounce of my heart and 
soul, I shall play the music overflowing 
from within me! Please enjoy it to the 
very end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind Sounds of Earth stood musicians 
holding various instruments. Though small 
in scale, it was a complete orchestra.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only one customer. Faced with such lavish 
hospitality, they couldn't hide their 
bewilderment. As for how things came to 
this, let us turn back the clock a bit—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttore, do you have a moment?
choice_data_list:
Earth? I thought you went back to the 
dorm...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttrice, do you have a moment?
choice_data_list:
Earth? I thought you went back to the 
dorm...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I just really wanted to give this to you. 
Don't worry, I'll barely make it back 
before curfew."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What was handed over was a message card. 
With Christmas just around the corner, it 
was easy to tell it was an invitation of 
some sort."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to hold a concert for 
you. I heard you were free that day— would 
you accept my invitation?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
'O sole mio! I had full faith you would 
give me that answer!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to entertain you on the finest 
stage. Look forward to the day! Ciao!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since it was right before curfew, Sounds 
of Earth quickly delivered his message and 
hurried off in a flash...
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, where's the venue?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
He even called it a "Concert just for 
you." A park with illuminated night views 
would be an easy spot, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the invitation, I could hardly 
believe my eyes. Written on it was a 
banquet hall at a famous hotel often used 
for wedding receptions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so arrived the day of the concert. 
Upon arriving at the venue, Sounds of 
Earth and musicians holding various 
instruments were there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth's mother is also among 
them. The crowd gathered here seems to be 
members of the orchestra where she serves 
as concertmaster.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, this is my beloved direttore! 
Give him a round of thunderous applause!
choice_data_list: You don't have to hype it up that much...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, this is my beloved direttrice! 
Give her a round of thunderous applause!
choice_data_list: You don't have to hype it up that much...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Didn't I say 
this concert was for you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's a Christmas party today, is 
it not? Let us dance, sing, and converse 
together. For this is a special day to 
spend with all our family...!
choice_data_list: Family... Wait, does that include me!?
Family... Wait, does that include me!?

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Look at you flustered like that, 
Trainer, you're adorable!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Earth really should have 
explained things properly to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're always taking such good care of our 
daughter, so we wanted to thank you 
properly. And then Earth invited us to the 
concert, you see?

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member
text_block_list.text:
When I talked to the hotel owner, they 
were kind enough to let us use this venue 
specially. It pays to work with all sorts 
of people, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So that's the story. You'll accept our 
feelings, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by Sounds of Earth, I sit on a 
solitary chair placed right in front of 
the stage. The lights dim, and the concert 
begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First up is her favorite: the violin. With 
flowing strokes of the bow, she plays a 
passionate melody that stirs the hearts of 
all who listen...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Rat-tat-tat-tan! Rat-tat-tat-tan! 
Ran-tat-tah, ran-tat-tah, taka-taka-tan, 
rat-tah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next, the delightful-looking concertina. 
The rhythm hummed along with its tune is 
so brisk it makes you want to dance!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
La tua musica travolge il mio mondo♪ 
Cantano i fiori, il vento e il sole 
giocondo♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next was a performance singing at a grand 
piano. Though I couldn't understand the 
lyrics, my chest trembled, and before I 
knew it, tears were rolling down my 
cheeks...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She played more pieces after that, 
switching instruments and melodies. 
Combined with the accompaniment of 
top-tier orchestra musicians, every 
performance was nothing short of 
magnificent...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
O Dio mio! Why must the good times fly by 
so fast!?
choice_data_list: That was fun! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No, Direttore! I have yet to fully convey 
my feelings to you! I cherish you so much, 
much more...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No, Direttrice! I have yet to fully convey 
my feelings to you! I cherish you so much, 
much more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth leans in close. Still 
caught up in the excitement of the 
concert, breathless, she begins to speak 
passionately.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If I were to describe your heart, it is 
like the sky! It welcomes freely soaring 
birds, guides them, and inspires dreams of 
an unknown world!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes are just like the ocean. Singing 
the mystic sound of waves in the lightless 
abyss. I want to hear more! I want to feel 
it with my whole being!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your soul is passionate, radiant, and 
mighty! It makes even the midsummer sun 
pale in comparison! Without your 
brilliance, who could possibly live on...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Desperate to stop Sounds of Earth, who is 
unusually fired up, I look around for 
help. However, the orchestra members...

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo! That's our Earth-chan! Way to 
go~!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
To receive all of Angelo's love all to 
yourself... I'm getting just a little 
jealous~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Sounds of Earth's mother, the 
orchestra members cheered and whistled. 
The overwhelming excitement made my face 
flush hot...

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Just kidding. Angelo, you're 
troubling Trainer too. That's enough for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oops... forgive me. I was so overwhelmed 
with excitement that I completely lost 
myself.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's true that she loves you very 
much. Honestly, whenever this girl opens 
her mouth, it's always Trainer this, 
Trainer that.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being relied upon to that extent genuinely 
makes me happy as a Trainer. Taking this 
as a good opportunity, I reaffirm my 
determination to her.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yes...?
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure Earth has the best session 
ever

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttore...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttrice...!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Earth has truly... been blessed with a 
wonderful Trainer. We are fortunate 
indeed. Both my daughter and I."

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the race. Please 
take good care of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, the snacks should be arriving soon. 
Earth, go call the staff over.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Got it. I'll be right back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while nibbling on the prepared 
snacks, we chatted pleasantly with the 
orchestra members.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the delightful time spent with 
Sounds of Earth and the orchestra members 
flew by in the blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our pleasant conversation carried us all 
the way to parting time. She mentioned 
wanting to take a quiet path, so we chose 
an empty road to head toward the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Can something be heard even in this 
silence? As I strained my ears to listen 
closely, a sudden thud came from inside my 
bag."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remembered buying a gift to thank her 
for the concert. In a hurry, I pulled out 
the package and handed it to her.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a present?! I'm so happy! Can I open 
it right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I bought was hand cream. Thinking 
hands are vital when playing an 
instrument, I picked a smooth, non-greasy 
type that won't smudge it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Direttore...! Ah, how is it that you 
understand me so well?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Direttrice...! Ah, why do you understand 
me so deeply?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth hugs me. I fluster and try 
to push her back, but she wraps her arms 
around me with even greater strength.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear my heartbeat? It's pounding 
so fiercely it drowns out even the noise 
of the city...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"You have given me such a thrilling 
rush... A melody far too grand to merely 
be an overture!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie. Ti amo...! I am so blessed to be 
born on this Earth. Because my 
conductor—because you are here...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie. Ti amo...! I am so blessed to be 
born on this Earth. Because my 
conductor—because you are here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While somewhat overwhelmed by such an 
immense display of affection, there is no 
way I could not be happy to receive this 
much trust.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Earth has truly... been blessed with a 
wonderful Trainer. We are fortunate 
indeed. Both my daughter and I."

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the race. Please 
take good care of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To deliver the greatest session"— I will 
without fail fulfill the vow I made to her 
mother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the conductor who plays her melody!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the conductor who plays her melody!
